title: Dental PPO Plans Provision: Earlier Coverage Credited toward the Initial Waiting Period on Reprocessing
content:
**Provision.** For a line of the Dental PPO Plans reprocessed after a denial for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date (a reprocessed initial-wait line), the months credited toward the line's waiting period follow the person's earlier coverage. The months credited shorten that waiting period, never below zero, and so decide the patient share on such a line.

| Order | Condition (all parts must hold) | Months credited |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The plan credits prior coverage month for month, and the person has an earlier DHMO enrollment | The calendar months from the month that DHMO coverage took effect through the month it ended, both months counted (DHMO coverage always takes effect on the first of a month) |
| 2 | The plan credits prior coverage month for month, no such DHMO enrollment exists, and the enrollment shows documented prior coverage months whose prior coverage end date is no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date | Those documented prior coverage months |
| 3 | Otherwise | None |

The first condition that holds decides.

**Earlier DHMO enrollment.** The person's earlier DHMO enrollment is the person's own terminated enrollment in Cascade's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans, matched by name and date of birth, that ended on the day before the Dental PPO enrollment's coverage effective date (a move from the DHMO with no break in coverage). The person's DHMO services are read only from that enrollment's own service records, never from another enrollment of the same subscriber.

**Which plans credit month for month.** Value 1000, Classic 1250, Plus 1500, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500 credit prior coverage month for month; Preventive 750 credits none, so on Preventive 750 no months are credited. The 63-day gap is the same on every plan.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)
- Documented prior coverage ended 63 days before the coverage effective date, no DHMO enrollment, month-for-month plan: the documented months are credited. Ended 64 days before: no months are credited.
- DHMO coverage took effect 1 March and ended 31 January of the following year; the Dental PPO coverage took effect 1 February: the DHMO enrollment ended the day before, so March through January is credited, 11 months. Against a 12-month waiting period, 1 month remains.
- DHMO coverage ended 15 January and the Dental PPO coverage took effect 1 February: it did not end the day before, so it is not an earlier DHMO enrollment for this provision.
